Name: Joja Cola Speed Buff
Author: Giever
Description:
This is my first mod, so please be gentle!

I get what ConcernedApe was going for by putting Joja Cola under the Trash category and making it rather useless, but as a caffeinated soda drinker I thought it would be nice to give it some benefit. This mod gives Joja Cola a +1 Speed buff for around a minute (so a little shorter than Coffee's).

In an attempt to balance it out and retain the original idea behind the item I've lowered the nutritional value as much possible, so it now only gives +3 Energy and +1 Health (the same as Coffee, actually). I don't really want to change the prices for items, but 75g for a speed buff that's almost as good as Coffee's (at 300g) is perhaps a bit ridiculous, so if anyone has any good balancing recommendations I'd be happy to consider them.


[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley\Mods.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b]
[size=3]Uninstallation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Simply delete the folder from Stardew Valley\Mods.
[/list]
